author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: प्रतिज्ञाते ज्ञाने आदरजननाय तस्य दौर्लभ्यमाह ॥  मनुष्यणामिति ।  कश्चिदेव पुण्यवान्पुरुषः सिद्धये ज्ञानाय यतति यतते ।  यततां ज्ञानार्थं यतमानानामपि मध्ये कश्चिदेव सिद्धिमान्भवतीति योज्यम् ।  सिद्धानां ज्ञानिनामपि मध्ये कश्चिदेव तत्त्वतो मां वेत्ति यथावज्जानाति ॥ ७.३॥
translation: Among thousands of men, there is (but) someone who strives for knowledge; even among those that strive for it [there is but one who becomes accomplished of knowledge]; even among those who are accomplished of knowledge, there is but one who knows Me as I am. (3) V. But one: only one who has a store of merit and who is blessed. After Yatatâmapi clause is supplied of which the translation is given within brackets. Learning and knowledge, however necessary and useful they be, are different from the first-hand perception of truth. Such wisdom is gained by very, very few and the rarity as well as the distinction are clearly seen from supplying the clause. (3) A. With this introduction the promised Gnana, that which is to be known, is now pointed out to begin with, in the following four verses.
